name: Marcus Sextius (Tesserarius)
notes: Watch officer. Delivers the nightly password, checks posts, logs the watch. Lorica Squamata, Galea Attica, Scutum.
gm_notes: NPC holder of the Tesserarius role. Not player-controlled. Knows every guard post and which ones are currently understaffed. Loyal to Varro. Will report irregularities up the chain unless convinced otherwise.
